non_claims.text: No officer, civilian, incident, lawsuit, or settlement record is asserted by this revision.
The source rows admitted in rev0003 are not misconduct findings against any person.
A DOJ source-page status label is not a final current legal status without current docket/source recheck.
A findings report, complaint, consent decree, settlement agreement, press release, or news item does not collapse into a person-level culpability claim.
The archive is not a Brady/Giglio list, employment blacklist, officer risk score, or police intelligence product.
Public-record legality does not by itself authorize public display.
The DOJ SLS pilot is a source-graph pilot, not a comprehensive national misconduct database.
A PDF URL accession is not a document-content summary.
A document-effect atom is not an unqualified current-status claim.
A motion or response is not a court order, even when linked by DOJ.
A closing letter is an official source signal, not a court order or blanket endorsement.
No person entity may be created from public PDFs in this revision.
A page shell is not a public department accusation page.
A document role is not a document finding or content summary.
A missingness banner does not imply absence of misconduct, absence of reform, or absence of liability.
A payload envelope is not a payload.
A sidecar template is not a live source digest.
A failed fetch or changed redirect is not evidence that a public record never existed.
A source-page anchor is not a preserved source.
A source-page delta sentinel is not a public delta claim.
No source-page structural delta, public delta note, payload, content summary, person record, incident record, or public current-status claim is admitted in rev0014.
A dream is not a claim, product commitment, or data admission.
A telos statement is not permission to bypass evidence, privacy, due-process, freshness, or correction gates.
A phase-bound constraint may be relaxed only after the cube names what it has earned.
Open horizon entries are possibility memory, not implementation commitments.
An evidence atom type definition is not a live evidence atom.
A claim candidate template is not an admitted claim or public claim.
Source voice grammar is a guardrail, not public copy approval.
A modality assignment cannot promote allegation, settlement, motion, missingness, or source label into a stronger claim.
Defeater classes are review machinery; no live claims are defeated in rev0018 because no live claims are admitted.
Synthetic claim-candidate fixtures are fictional and must not be mistaken for source records.
A source family is not a source row, source payload, evidence atom, claim candidate, or public claim.
A pilot candidate route is not a selected live pilot.
A root refactor plan is not a file move.
An interoperability contract is not permission to import an external dataset.
Review-office assignment is navigation metadata, not authority to bypass gates.
A review packet is not an admission of a source row, evidence atom, claim candidate, public display, or fact.
A packet state or risk tier is an operating constraint, not a claim about misconduct or legal status.
A synthetic fixture blueprint is not live data and must not be treated as a real case, officer, incident, lawsuit, settlement, or source payload.
A validator facet or make-lint pass verifies release structure, not factual truth.

prohibited_collapses.rule: Never present an allegation as a finding.
Only state admission if source text says admission.
Name-only linkage remains tentative/unmatched.
Legal availability does not settle ethical display.
Official statement may be a source, not the whole record.
A source row says a carrier exists; it does not assert the truth of allegations or findings inside the carrier.
Display source-page status with timestamp and verify current court/source status separately.
Closure, dismissal, or termination changes current status; it does not delete the existence of prior public records.
A press release is a source signal and requires order/docket corroboration before current-status display.
A motion/request to terminate must not be described as termination without court order.
Same-owner conflict opens a ticket; do not automatically prefer newer source.
A status candidate remains internal/nonclaim until order/docket proof, source-family comparison, display review, and rollback triggers are complete.
Mixed rows require child-agency status objects before display.
An agency mentioned in an official event but absent from current source-row seed becomes a ghost carrier candidate, not an absence claim.
Resolved URL and page count do not authorize a full summary.
Document-stated effect remains historical/noncurrent until freshness and rollback gates pass.
Use carrier-specific language for DOJ letters.
Names in PDFs are not entity-resolution input in rev0007.
A display shell may only show source inventory and missingness until claim-promotion gates pass.
Classifying a document label for triage does not assert the contents of the document.
Missing or unfrozen documents do not imply absence of misconduct, absence of discipline, absence of reform, or absence of litigation.
Permission for source-inventory modules does not authorize current-status, person, incident, lawsuit-merits, or settlement modules.
An envelope controls future capture; it does not preserve or prove source contents.
A queued preflight is not a completed scan or display permission.
A digest proves byte identity only; it does not summarize or interpret content.
Dreams and horizon entries remain nonclaims until separately scoped, gated, and implemented.
No-person, DOJ-first, and source-inventory-first postures must be re-evaluated when gates mature.
The active pilot trains methods; it does not define total scope.

nonclaims.text: Matter objects are source-scoped nonclaims and must not be displayed as department wrongdoing findings.
Document-label census rows do not imply the content, truth, or current force of the linked document.
Status events in rev0004 do not assert current legal status; they preserve source observations and fragility flags.
Official DOJ news-event rows are source-scoped nonclaims and must not be displayed as current legal status.
Status reconciliation tickets do not decide which source is correct; they preserve the need for order/docket/source-family recheck.
A motion to terminate is not a termination order.
Closure, dismissal, termination, or retraction does not delete earlier public source records.
Current-status candidates are structured hypotheses, not admitted current legal status.
Order accession candidates are retrieval/proof-plan rows and do not assert order content.
Child agency status objects do not authorize public status display.
Public status card copy candidates are not public release artifacts.
Ghost carrier candidates prevent absence inference and do not assert an agency had or has a DOJ matter.
A source-family signal conflict is not a resolved current status.
A court-effect atom is not a public banner until freshness and display gates pass.
Closure/completion/retraction language never deletes historical public-record carriers from the cube.
Resolved DOJ URLs do not authorize content summaries or current-status claims.
A fetch anomaly is not evidence that a source does not exist.
Public citation badges remain internal copy candidates only.

items.text: No canonical agency records, public agency pages, denominator claims, maps, officer rosters, incident lists, or status banners are admitted in rev0010.

items.statement: A citation is not a preserved source.
A resolved URL is not document content.
A payload hash is not a privacy scan or a claim review.
Public record does not mean public payload display.
A source mutation or dead link does not erase historical source custody.
A source-page anchor is not a preserved source.
A source-page delta sentinel is not a public delta claim.
A document link anchor is not a document payload.
A provenance activity template is not a live provenance event.
A volatile source-family watch is not a current-status claim.
